title: Update to 0.1.0
changelog: A rebuilt LifeOS, in the same place you left it. Your messages are read again and your transactions rebuilt from them, so the ledger matches the inbox: Fuliza-funded payments are marked, declined attempts and Fuliza repayments no longer count as spending, and transfers between your own accounts are recognised. Background import is calmer too: one notice a day at most, and the morning summary only when you have switched it on and set a time.
